comments.text: Been a Rails dev since Rails v1 and I have to say that I'm intrigued by the Laravel ecosystem, especially the pre-made stuff to easily drop in additional functionality with little to no effort, and the well-made tools that Herd and Forge offer, especially the automated deployment to servers that can be set up with a mouse click. Also the starter kits save a lot of work. But still, the Ruby syntax is way more elegant than the PHP syntax. I really miss defining things in just a few words, instead of the several lines of PHP code necessary to declare the same thing. And although Rails already is a bit too complex for many things, Laravel said "Hold my beer!" and created a structure which is more complicated than necessary.
